features.title: Read a stored Session log by its window, not its whole event list
features.summary: Serve the newest events, the first events and the events a predicate selects from one bounded byte window of the JSONL zstd log, so a reader that needs a few events never decodes 86 MB of a large Session; the tail also folds the projection cache's checkpoint over the window.
failureModes: A backend, format or log the window cannot parse answers undefined, and the caller falls back to the full read instead of receiving a short window.
A projection checkpoint that lags past the decoded window refuses to restore, so a fold never starts from rows the window cannot prove.

verification.testName: decodes the same events as the full log read, from the newest frames back to the first
finds the newest matching events without decoding a log larger than the window
reads the first events of a log far larger than the head window
answers undefined for a Host with no JSONL persistence backend

telemetry.reason: The package performs file reads for a calling Host plugin, which owns the span and records the window's bytes and phases as attributes.

ioDelegation.reason: Every open runs inside the calling plugin's session tail read span, which records the window's bytes, frames and per-phase timings.
